name: datum-claude-code-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for working with Datum Cloud products

plugins.name: datum-cloud
plugins.description: Sign in to Datum Cloud and connect Claude to your projects through the Datum MCP server, with skills for CI service accounts and handing questions to Patch

plugins.name: datum-networking
plugins.description: Create and troubleshoot Datum Cloud load balancers, hostnames, domains and networks, using the same diagnosis Datum's own assistant runs

plugins.name: milo-activity
plugins.description: Query audit logs, investigate incidents, and author ActivityPolicies using the Milo Activity service

plugins.name: milo-observe
plugins.description: Query project logs, export metrics to Grafana Cloud, and read the status metrics Datum publishes for your resources
